stages.name: 7 · Write-up
stages.order_notes:
The objectives in Write-up, in order:

1. **Decide: what the export waits for** (refusal:export-gate, refusal:input-changed). These are not Write-up's own questions. Each exit reopens the stage that owns it, and the bar drops back with the reason. They come first because the engine refuses the whole export (HTTP 409, never a partial bundle) while any is open.
2. **Decide: merge the tracks** (only with several goals). This fixes the manuscript's outline: shared Methods sections once, then each track's statistical methods and Results. Placement and numbering depend on it.
3. **Decide: placement and wording.** Each exhibit's placement and wording was set in Results and is reviewed here. The floor is enforced: under inference the locked primary always stays in Results, and anything left out goes to the Supplement and stays listed. This must precede author text and export because \label/\ref numbering, the Supplement's contents and the manuscript gate all follow placement.
4. **Decide: Discussion drafts.** The drafted limitations, plus any late-born noticing without a disposition.
5. **Decide: identifiable values.** Only when that noticing fires.
6. **Decide: author-owed items.** Optional, never blocking; each becomes \todo.
7. **Confirm** (one sweep, last, per the ruling). It appears only if the small-cell threshold applies; Write-up otherwise has no number-changing default, so the sweep is usually absent.
8. **For the record** (collapsed, outside progress). The guideline order, folded and kept answers, restated counts, the reproducibility sentence, the plan's wording and hash, Table 2's exposure-only rule, the declared result, the answered checklist items, provenance and replay.

The one primary action closes the stage: Export (bundle, Overleaf, Word). Under prediction, a one-line notice above it says that exporting counts every score as seen.
boundary_issues: **Post-lock changes (inference).** The ruling says 'inference after the lock turns a change into a secondary analysis'. The engine instead refits the primary on the new answers: state folds to the latest record, so Table 2's Model 2 changes. Only the sentence is marked 'After the estimates were seen' (decisions.disclose; plan_lock.py 'After'). Write-up would report the changed analysis as primary.

**Placement and wording.** They are ruled into Results but consumed, and editable, in Write-up. With no decision kind for either, replay cannot reproduce the manuscript and the selective-reporting floor cannot be enforced in the engine.

**The rail runs in every stage.** It spans stages 1–6 while Write-up is stage 7. Decide which manuscript elements count toward Write-up's segment: proposed, only the gate, placement review, Discussion drafts and export.

**The export gate reads the whole interview.** gate.missing counts every open or waiting Router question across all stages. Quest-log Confirm sweeps are not engine records, so they are not gated. Decide whether Write-up requires every stage's Confirm sweep to be done.

**open_seal must sit before Write-up.** open_seal is the last QUESTION_KEY and is the prediction declaration. The gate names it as plan_open when a holdout is drawn, so its place (end of Models or start of Results) must come before Write-up.

**Exporting under prediction changes Results.** It counts every family's cross-validated score as seen (service.export → selection.note_seen). With no holdout, the gate does not wait for a declaration, so the press itself changes what Results may declare afterwards.

**Study design is asked too late.** The study-design name (INBOX 251) is needed by STROBE 4 and by not-applicable marking in Write-up. It belongs to Your question or Who's in, with the designed-experiments milestone's design declaration.

**Late-born noticings are uncovered.** O3/O4 noticings born after the fit (UNDERSTANDING_LAYER §2.7) fall outside 'decided or dismissed before the lock or the seal'. They need a disposition in Results or in Write-up before export.

**Ruling 1 removed 'Leave as a limitation' at the lock** (UNDERSTANDING_LAYER §7). §2.6's open_at_lock limitation path is therefore dead. Limitation drafts in Write-up come only from disclosure or limitation feeds, and §2.5/§2.6 should be amended to match.

**Section order differs from stage order.** The methods are ordered by guideline (STROBE-nut or TRIPOD+AI; export/methods.py:SECTION_OF), not by the seven stages. A sentence's 'change' link must map its decision kind back to the quest stage that asks it. For example, set_purpose sits under STROBE 'Study design' but is asked in Your question.

**Sequential tracks against a single-purpose engine.** The engine holds one purpose per project. A second track's set_purpose after the first track's lock would be recorded as after_estimates, and checklist_of picks one guideline. The merge cannot happen in Write-up without track-scoped state.

**Methods editing is unruled.** The ruling covers only Results wording ('choose a wording or write your own'). The engine's contract says every methods sentence is the record's own, and gate 7 traces every number. Proposed: methods change only by changing the decision (its stated phrase), with author notes as \todo.

**Figure numbering.** Numbers are fixed in the engine (figures.participant_flow number=1; lineage 'Figure 2'; tables titled 'Table 2'), but placement decides which exhibits exist and in what order. Numbering must move to the manuscript model.
gaps: **No export UI.** GET /export and GET /checklist have no client function. GET /methods and GET /plan have client functions (api/client.ts) but no component. Checked at HEAD 2627066d, which matches the inventory taken at caa9563.

**Manuscript choices are not recorded.** No decision kinds exist for exhibit placement, result wording (drafted or own), author-owed text, study design, track merge or the small-cell threshold. So the manuscript is not a function of decisions.jsonl, and neither replay nor the DoD gate 7 manuscript gate can check it.
**No manuscript model or writers.** Nothing renders both LaTeX and Word from one model. There is no LaTeX/Overleaf writer (Classic ml/latex_report.py is the only reference) and no docx code anywhere.

**No citation registry.** Citations are free text in MethodContract.sources and inside voice sentences, and DOIs sit only in audit/claims-ledger.md. refs.bib and the Crossref check are not possible yet.
**Manuscript gate (DoD gate 7) not built.** provenance.estimates covers the numbers in tables but not numbers in prose, captions or user wordings.

**The bundle tabulates only part of what ran** (gate.result_stages: cohort, design, fit, effects, calibration). Missing: sensitivity, secondary, causal, time_varying, modification, explain, evaluation (decision curve, subgroups, design-based scores), substitution, scales and usual_intake results and paragraphs (INBOX 250, 257, 259). This breaks 'every analysis that was run stays listed'.

**Thread layer not built** (UNDERSTANDING_LAYER U1, U4, U7, U8). So there are no thread sentences, S1, clean-check list, IDA paragraph, limitation drafts, 'noticed' links, checklist thread anchors or PROBAST/ROBINS evidence table. 321 of 367 threads have a reporting consumer.

**Checklists.** Only STROBE-nut (58 items, 31 with rules) and TRIPOD+AI (52 items, 17 with rules) exist. CONSORT, RECORD, STROBE-ME, MIAME/MINSEQE and STARD are absent. Items that apply 'if applicable' cannot be marked not applicable (INBOX 251).
**Tracks and Describe absent.** decisions.Purpose is Literal['prediction','inference']: there is no Describe goal and no track id on records. The project has one checklist, one bundle and one gate.
**Post-lock secondary analysis (inference) and kept earlier versions (prediction) not built.** set_recipe, set_tuning and declare_version are absent from decisions.py.

**Figures.** Numbering is hard-coded (Figure 1, Figure 2, and 'Table 2' for both the Table 2 and performance tables). Missing: an omics samples-and-features flow, a CONSORT flow, an analysis-flowchart figure, Table 1, 'Add to the supplement' on SaveMenu, PNG at 3x and LaTeX tables.

**No canvas view for documents or exhibits.** The closed view vocabulary (row_flow, lineage, distribution, relationship, table_focus) has no view for a document page or a table exhibit, so the Write-up canvas has nothing to show the manuscript or bundle in. Adding one is a recorded design decision (UNDERSTANDING_LAYER §3.4).
**No disclosure control.** Nothing suppresses small cells or strips identifier values from sentences and figures (shared-identifiable-values-in-the-export is 'new').
**No teaching entry for the export or Write-up.** teaching/content.py keys end at modification, and no purpose-registry entry exists for Write-up elements.

**Methods reference defect.** reference/methods.py prints 'Under prediction it is named in the in-fold group … the manuscript bundle … were fitted' for manuscript_export, because it prints for every contract with `short`. contracts.paragraph correctly checks slot_of, so only the generated METHODS_REFERENCE.md is wrong.

**Prototypes not in production.** The rail and full-width manuscript exist only as fixture prototypes in .worktrees/calm (calm-kit ManuscriptRail; methods-questlog Doc.tsx; methods-document Document.tsx).
**Readings not in the bundle.** The settled readings sit inside the select-models sentence instead of a supplementary table (INBOX 249). GET /readings is built but unused.
